Prices

Questions

How much do projects in mobile app development cost?
An MVP in this group costs $9,000–100,000 (UZS 108–1,205 mln), a full version up to $400,000. The exact price depends on the solution, the integrations and the scope.
How long does it take?
An MVP takes 6–24 weeks, a full version 12–60 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
App Store and Google Play accounts; Logo, colours and texts; One person who makes the decisions.
